correctness.rationale: The center c flips only if both neighbors have the same different color b. Given that flip, each neighbor either stays b or copies the old center color c, with a copy exactly when its outer neighbor is c; the center can flip twice only if both copies occur. If the center stays c, a neighbor can only stay put or copy c, so updated agreement of both neighbors away from c would already have forced the center to flip. These exhaust the local possibilities, even when sites in the five-site notation coincide modulo n. Thus triple-AND erosion iterates to an alternating two-color word of length 2t+3. An infinite alternating cyclic word requires even n and produces a true two-cycle; counting ordered first colors gives q(q-1) states. A noncheckerboard odd ring allows at most n alternating letters, and a noncheckerboard even ring at most n-1. A full alternating linear word on an odd ring and a length n-1 alternating run with a third last color on an even ring attain the claimed bounds. For fixed L=2t+3, p=(q-1)/q^(L-1) and the joint event at offsets s=1,...,L-2 costs p q^(-s), because overlap of at least two letters fixes both colors; one-letter overlap gives independent indicators. Hence variance is at most lambda_n(1+O_L(1/q)). For bounded positive means the block argument loses o(1) expected hits at boundaries (including any last partial block), has probability o(1) of any multiple-hit block, and gives independent block-hit indicators of maximal probability o(1). This proves Poisson convergence, with the zero and diverging regimes following by Markov and the variance bound. At adjacent deadlines the expected counts differ by factors q^2, giving concentration on t and t+1, also at t=0 since T>=0. Frozen finite checks and output were inspected, not rerun; the stochastic and infinite-size assertions follow from the proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Replacing 2 with q in the binary theorem is not a valid specialization. In a binary ring a run of adjacent disagreements is automatically alternating; with three or more colors that implication fails. Further, binary adjacent extensions at the extreme scale can cluster with nonvanishing conditional probability, whereas categorical overlapping windows here extend with conditional probability O(1/q). This changes the Poisson analysis, not just a parameter name.
